entry.title: FUZZ -THORPY FX EAO ___NEW ___ a Burns Buzzaround clone
entry.content:
$530.00 USD
Thorpy FX..EAO  FUZZ
This time we get what appears to be a once a year Ltd. Ed. Fuzz. 
This year it comes in pink. It is based on the Burns Buzzaround 
made famous by Robert Fripp on King Crimson's first Album. 
Fripp soon replaced it with a Big Muff Triangle as the Burns 
is unreliable and it cuts the level going to the amp. 
     CONCLUSION ___
This time we get like we always get. A very nice Fuzz 
at an obscene price. Worth at the very most half the 
money. Just buy the bog standard Electro Harmonix 
Triangle Muff at $115.00 USD. 
...they literally sound as good but are tighter with a balzy attack.

entry.title: FUZZ- WARM AUDIO The Black Keys Peach Fuzz ___NEW___ signature Fuzz?
entry.content:
$200.00 USD
 WARM AUDIO
THE BLACK KEYS 
 P e a c h   F u z z 
In spite of the marketing verbal flatulence this is not a one 
size fits all pedal. It is a 70's Foxy Fuzz of which Warm Audio 
already cloned. This is simply v.2 in a new board friendly 
enclosure. The Layout is Volume, Tone and Gain. A toggle 
lets you use a footswitch for hold.
Conclusion __
Nice enough but the $30.00 USD Behringer SF300 
Super Fuzz is near virtually the same thing minus 
the low octave & footswich. The sound is a bit nastier 
but otherwise the same. I have had mine 
for years with no problems.

entry.title: TREBLE BOOSTER- VOX Treble Booster ___NEW ___Rangemaster Treble Booster clone

entry.title: OVERDRIVE- THIMBLE WASP FX Black & Blue ___NEW ___ a high gain original ???
entry.content:
THIMBLE WASP EFFECTS
 Black & Blue      
$200.00 USD
Not a lot of info about this Columbus Ohio brand or this product. 
This appears to be their only Overdrive pedal? 
It is a high gain unit. Likely a OpAmp with clipping diodes circuit 
in the vein of a BOSS DS-1?
The layout is Bass, Mids, Treble, Gain and Volume. It has both a boost and footswitch to trigger it on. There is a toggle on the 
side without any info why? My best guess that it flushes 
the toilet on the top floor.
CONCLUSION __
I will assume their claim it is their original take on something 
to fit the genre. That said it sounds at minimum similar to 
a lot of what's out there. I feel there are a lot of high gain OD's/Distortion boxes & even some Fuzz pedals that could 
take it on and at worse be a tie for around $50.00 USD.
The knobs lighting up is needless expense, WTF. 
That said I like it. It has personality.
The company is new and I had a quick listen to their 
other pedals that are indeed worth a deep dive & a Post.

entry.title: OVERDRIVE- MOSKY AUDIO 1959 Dist. ___NEW___clone Ravenstone 1959 via Marshall
entry.content:
MOSKY AUDIO
1959 Distortion 

$55.00 USD
The Marshall 1959 Super Lead Pedal has been a big success. It really has tried to nail the amp. 
99% of most MIAB pedals literally try to get the heavily processed sound we hear on recordings. Add to that many of these recordings are recording a Marshall that is both heavily modified and then the player has put a dirt pedal like a Fuzz or a Boost or an OD slamming 
the amp. The layout is Volume, Tone, Gain and Tight/high pass filter.   
CONCLUSION __

entry.title: CLIPPER- RECOVERY FX & DEVICES Clipping ___NEW___ damn clever invention
entry.content:
RECOVERY 
EFFECTS & DEVICES
 CLIPPING 
$145.00 USD
I will be straight up & honest. I thought at first hearing about this
it was a cheap gimmick & a total con. In fact laughable. OOPS!
If you are a Fuzz guy you may know that a Germanium Fuzz can sound  
fat and warm and its rich overtones give the treble content dancing 
overtones and rich harmonics. This box simply puts clipping diodes 
across the input signal. There is not any  preamp section to crank the 
signal so it doesn't need  electricity.  A toggle lets you choose between 
a 1N270 or a 1N34A Germanium diode to clip input signal.
CONCLUSION ___
Even going straight into a clean amp gives you a very transparent 
sound with a nice fat breadth to the signal and a bit of bite that 
is very pleasing. The price is a bit of an ouch. I can not help to 
think half of it, perhaps $75 would be fair.

link.title: CLIPPER- RECOVERY FX & DEVICES Clipping ___NEW___ damn clever invention

entry.title: FUZZ- COSMODIO INSTRUMENTS Glitch Witch ... MOSFET Fuzz
entry.content:
C O S M O D I O   I N S T R U M E N T S
GLITCH WITCH    
$280.00 USD
The heart of this is MOSFETS. Often referred to as just a FET.
A FET is a transistor that can be used to emulate a tube. However by adding diodes or simply overloading the 
input it can turn the sound into a Fuzz. In fact so much as 
to head into Tone Bender territory or beyond.
The layout is Volume, Treble, Bass, Gate and Gain. Divide, 
Division and Depth scramble the sound but give you enough 
control to keep musical enough to play a tune or to go into 
Star Wars or Shoegaze city. 
             CONCLUSION __
An impressive mix of controlled and musical sound 
and any level of of chaos. A one size fits all with 
both the benefits and rather obvious handicaps 
all such pedals have.

link.title: FUZZ- COSMODIO INSTRUMENTS Glitch Witch ... MOSFET Fuzz
